resources.string: Paste the launch URL dsh-launch printed — the Tailscale .ts.net address ending in ?token=… The session it signs in lasts 30 days.
Could not load that address. Check the URL and that Tailscale is connected.
Photo access is needed to attach images. Allow it in Settings to attach from gallery.
The harness wants a sign-in. Copy the ?token=… launch URL printed by dsh-launch (or dsh-launch.ps1) and paste it above; it is the only copy, by design.
The web content keeps failing to start (likely low memory). It will reload on the next attempt — check the harness is still running.
